title: AI模型限制难执行：政府意在评估能力，彭博策略师说透
speaker: Cameron Christ

segments.en: I should say with OpenAI facing similar restrictions from the US government.
segments.zh: OpenAI也面临美国政府的类似限制。

segments.en: There is some palpable displeasure from Sam Altman about the way that this is being restricted, the way that the government is imposing this regulation on these two AI companies.
segments.zh: Sam Altman对政府限制这两家AI公司的方式明显不满。

segments.en: I mean, look, the government is definitely finding it hard to enforce this.
segments.zh: 政府确实发现难以执行这些限制。

segments.en: Even though Anthropic's fable model was restricted from being accessed by foreign nations and really anyone outside US citizens, it's very hard to enforce in practice.
segments.zh: 尽管Anthropic的模型被限制向外国人提供，但实际执行很难。

segments.en: And at the end of the day, I think what the government is looking for here is really understanding the capabilities of these latest models.
segments.zh: 归根结底，政府是想了解这些最新模型的能力。

segments.en: What is the incremental capability and could it be a risk?
segments.zh: 增量能力是什么？是否构成风险？

segments.en: And so to my mind, it will be the same with OpenAI.
segments.zh: 我认为OpenAI也会是同样情况。

segments.en: I don't expect that to be a wide-ranging enforcement in terms of preventing model access for a very long time.
segments.zh: 我不预期会有长期广泛的模型访问限制。

segments.en: Cameron, we've also got SpaceX is going to join the Nasdaq in July, the Nasdaq 100.
segments.zh: SpaceX将于7月加入纳斯达克100指数。

segments.en: Since its IPO, it's now fallen basically back to where it started.
segments.zh: 自IPO以来，其股价已回落至起点。

segments.en: I want to ask you how that faded so quickly. Is that just kind of a natural correction?
segments.zh: 为何这么快就回落？这是自然修正吗？
